selection_basis: T primary development engineering choice from accepted exposed K2 descriptive comparison; neither independent winner nor operating promotion; C source preserved, no automatic C fit

base.baseline: E1b arm P (prequential-refit LightGBM 10+2 backbone, 199 prequential features)
base.change: neural classifier on the same 199 prequential pre-pitch features (N0), plus a transformer encoder over up to 32 earlier pitches of the same pitcher in the same game (N1)

training_rule.optimizer_fit: every accepted FIT key each epoch once; no drop_last
training_rule.epoch_basis: prior config max_epochs reused as fixed development schedule before new OOF results; optimality unclaimed

history.profiles: FIT donors only; donor game_date strictly before query date; frozen June30 for OOF
history.encoder: fresh FIT-only median/mean/std/continuous-column detection/quantile per fold
history.vocabulary: static original 19 types and 10 outcomes; no player embeddings learned
history.sequence: up to32 earlier pitches by same pitcher in same game including earlier July outcomes; retrospective intra-game prequential reconstruction
history.arrival: UNKNOWN: corrected September30 snapshot cannot establish July live-arrival or correction availability
history.query_current: current physical/outcome values forbidden in feature query; actual observed pitch type is a candidate-conditional covariate, not proof of intended action

row_policy.implementation: abc_corpus.project unchanged (every source row gets exactly one old fate), with labels10 = scale_safe.outcome_labels (model.py 26-41) and head_labels = scale_safe.head_labels
row_policy.pitch_type_unknown: accepted rows whose pitch_type is null or outside types are KEPT with pitch_type UNKNOWN and counted in projection.json pitch_type_mapped_unknown (the earlier ABC corpus had 367). Label eligibility is not action/service coverage.

research_acceptance: three fixed seed receipts and complete per-epoch consumed-key coverage
all OOF keys receive finite normalized raw probabilities
